payload.name: List Answers Enumerate All Stated Items
payload.description: When a question asks for a list of items a person made, read, watched, or otherwise did, use this to ensure every distinct item explicitly named in retrieved evidence is included in the answer.
content: For list-type questions such as 'What [items] has [person] [made/read/watched]?', after retrieval identify every distinct named item for which the subject is directly stated as performing the action.
Enumerate each named item separately, even if it appears in only one memory or is subsumed by a broader term; use the most specific name available.
If the same item appears in multiple memories with slight wording differences, report it once using the most complete name.
Stop after checking all retrieved memories; do not infer or add items not explicitly stated as performed by the subject.

solves: When answering list questions about things a person has made or done, the agent often omits directly supported items from retrieved evidence, leading to incomplete answers. This skill ensures the agent enumerates every distinct item explicitly named in the retrieved memories, rather than dropping some while adding loosely related alternatives.
